## Episode Thesis

Hosts and a guest fund manager, Erik, talk about the sharp VIX spike after Trump invaded Iran. They describe the sell-off as tech/AI-driven, with Anthropic under pressure from open-source models pushing AI token prices down. Erik expects no recession and sees the set-up for a classic year-end (tomte) rally. He says rate-sensitive Swedish real estate and low-volatility defensive stocks have been the best places to be over the past 6-8 weeks, and his small-cap fund moved real estate from underweight to neutral. The hosts are cautious that AI-sector funding could still make the market go 'åt skogen'.
